0022600002.text: Both the New York Knicks and Philadelphia 76ers open their 2026-27 seasons in this home game for the Knicks, and neither team has played yet. Josh Hart is day-to-day with ankle soreness and is a game-time decision for New York, while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (out with a ruptured Achilles) and Dominick Barlow (out with a back injury), and Adem Bona, Anfernee Simons and Dean Wade are day-to-day and game-time decisions, with Tacko Fall also listed day-to-day with a hip injury. The teams split their 2025-26 regular-season series 2-2, and the Knicks won their 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, most recently a 144-114 win in Philadelphia on May 10, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Knicks a 55% chance of winning.
